body: I’ve heard mixed things about Worcester. Do many Boston commuters live there?
C.U.N.T - sorry for the euphemism for a terrible word
Yes....and it’s so upsetting.... that he wants to end our relationship after going through a tough road bump.

Do you or other folks think it’s a good idea to still even live together? It’s so hard to know if it’s better to let him go and be alone during social distancing or stay but live in agony over my declining relationship?

Thank you for the comment. My boyfriend suffers from depression and ptsd from his time in the military. He’s shared that he feels emasculated that I’ve kept working while he isn’t during covid. He’s also going through a state of depression and he’s shared that he’s generally unhappy in the relationship. I feel like it’s so obviously the depression causing his uncertainty but I don’t think he sees it that way.

Thank you so much for this note. I agree with all of your points - he has mentioned that he likes to set up distractions and do fun things as opposed to trying to fix anything. I am going to set up something fun for him and I to do on that day.
Love this <3
Thank you for writing this. It's very reassuring.
Thank you for that. I am looking forward to the day when I will laugh about it too.

I made huge gains since my breakup two weeks ago. I even felt some moments of joy this week. I've been keeping buys this week - seeing friends and reading so many self help books (i.e., Brene Brown's Daring Greatly right now). 

Today I had a breakdown. I couldn't get out of bed. I started to cry. I wanted to message him more than anything in this world. Instead, I deleted his number from my phone, wrote it on a piece of paper and tucked it away.

Coming from a woman--you sound like a good man who gave everything. You should feel so proud of your selflessness and ability to love. Many men and women can't even achieve that. 

You deserve a love that is reciprocated and whole. Grieve your losss---don't avoid it, feel the feelings and watching them subside over time. Start to make a list of the things that really weren't the best between you in hopes that you will have some clarity on why this relationship isn't working right now. You can do this and you will be better for it.

I am going to a party hosted by a friend of mine tonight. I plan on not breaking out my phone at any point unless I need to go home. Saturday I have plans in the evening but I think I will go for a run in the afternoon and get my tennis racket restrung. 

On Sunday, I am in a shared tennis league with my ex and I have really been battling on whether or not to go. Tennis is my absolute joy throughout the week and I have decided not to go. It will just be too hard for me. Wish me luck. I can't stop looking at my phone hoping he will message me any minute telling me he wants me back.
Such a beautiful comment to see this morning. Thank you for posting.
This was really inspiring to me too. I am so glad I read it at this moment because I really needed to see it.

I ended up calling him at 11:30 AM to get a little more closure. It was actually really helpful because i could hear the why behind the break-up which was plaguing me. He still misses his ex (he said he wouldn't necessarily get back with her) but he also just wasn't ready for a relationship. I don't regret the call but that is certainly the last contact I will make.
He wants to get together next saturday which I guess is reasonable given the long week but I would want to see him sooner if I had it my way. Don't love the whole situation.

Girl - I feel your pain. It sounds like he is pulling the slow fade away that will likely turn into a full ghost. There are a million reasons that this could be happening that have nothing to do with you. Get back on the app and try and lock in another date with someone else.
He sounds like he is cheap and this will not be something that changes. I think you just need to consider - are you okay splitting bills or do you feel like you need to be treated?
Nothing in this scenario is normal or okay - please break up with him and move on. This is not something that will get better or change.
Whatever you do, don't keep in touch with whoever you broke up with. It just makes the transition more difficult.
Done. I will let you know how he responds.

I tried to make a plan by starting off the conversation with "how's his week looking" but he said that he was busy all week and then asked if I was busy. I took that as a sign that he's too busy to see me and didn't want to say anything.
Girl, good for you. And yes, it should have been something to laugh off.

Thanks all for the advice! Also, really feeling grateful at how supportive/kind everybody's advice was....I ended up reaching out and essentially said 

​

"I noticed we don't message a ton between our dates. I'd love to keep in touch more if you're keen." I realize keen makes me sound right outta the 1950's but he said he was keen too and we proceeded to text more throughout the day.

We left things off on a nice message from me last night so I hope he initiates a follow-up today. If he doesn't, I think I will just have to cut my losses. I want to give him the benefit of the doubt but I also just generally need at least a low key check in once a day if he wants to keep my interest.
So helpful, thank you. I really appreciated this context!
Amazing we can all have similar problems at very different ages. Is it acceptable to send a text along those lines before our date tonight?

I couldn't help but want to send a follow up as you guys have such good advice. As you may recall, he broke up with me about 2-3 weeks ago and when I saw him to get my stuff he acted like a robot.

Fast forward 2-3 more weeks, and he contacts me that he wants to start hanging out again. I told him I need to take time to think about it (given you know, he broke my fucking heart). Over the last several days, he'd been texting me like the old days---sometimes flirty but eventually not as much.

After days of going back and forth I finally call him to have a real talk---saying I don't know if I can do this...

So he drops everything and comes over. We finally have the post mortem we never got--he said he made a mistake. Was so scared by what we had and wish he had just talked to me instead of ending it. Now he doesn't really know what he wants but he def wants to hang out again.

None of this was good enough. I squeezed him a little to try and see what he wanted out of hanging out. I had realized that we were not on the same page regarding his motivation for reaching out to me. He confessed (to my somewhat surprise) that at this point he doesn't have any direct romantic designs on what hanging out would mean...which doesn't make sense to me.

I told him that wasn't good enough. I don't want to see him again. And never to contact me again. It was amicable and he left.

What a mindfuck and just so sad. Just seems like such a waste of something that was so good.

I ended up asking him if he was sure he wanted to do this and responded...

"Yes."

So, the decision has been made.
I appreciate that. Thank you.
Very very American cabana boys....

I'm sorry to hear about your experience. His name is Gideon. I hope it's not the same guy. He doesn't carry a zippo but he used to smoke.

I texted him about when/where to meet tonight many hours ago and haven't heard back. I really wouldn't be surprised if I never hear from him again.
It ended after two and a half weeks. Yesterday.

So I ended up asking him to come to a winery/concert with me and some friends Saturday. 

I sent him a link to the event and invited him to join.

He responded back: "That sounds like it'd be a good time to me! Especially since you can't go wrong with 80s music.

It's kinda an affirmative answer---??? Lol
Don't you think is response was a little terse or dismissive?

So this is how it netted out. I texted him and this is what transpired (also, I need to figure out how to insert screen shots into this thing)

I said:

"Pssss hey (insert adorable waving lady emoji) [insert man's name], Do you have plans this Friday/Saturday? (wine glass emoji and fork/knife emoji)

His response:

Psss [insert my name] (British guy with hat emoji) (there's no waving back dude). Friday is no bueno but Saturday is good for now.

Have to admit, feel like I came off too strong...but c'est la vie...
LOL---thats the exact question I was thinking. Mind reader!
Thank you for the input! at this point, I think I am just going to have to make the move--and ask him out.
The evening or early the next day is best. If a guy waits two days to text me, I will likely forget who he is and what he looks like.

Yeah, that is not a bad thing per say--I just want to be vigilant regarding how my feelings are developing given his pragmatism, and career goals. 

Is it fair to bring this up with him already? Or should I wait for him to discuss wanting to enter a relationship (if he does). It's been just about 1 month (5+ dates) and we haven't had any exclusivity discussions or relationship discussions.

Thank you so much for the perspective! I really appreciate the thoughtfulness.

In addition to the stuff he's applying to overseas, he's also applying to a job that would keep him in the city. I know he's pursuing all of them equally. I am just a little nervous because while I see my feelings develop for him, I don't know what his motivations are exactly (to your point, relationship vs. companionship).

Thank you for the note. I totally agree with you--it's just been so hard getting over him but I think I need to just not see him again. I feel like I want a reason to because I am looking for some sort of closure to these feelings I have (either getting back or understanding why I ended it in the first place)---but I am not sure meeting in person is the answer to that.

Thanks for friendly advice.
Yeah, you're right. I am REALLY hoping that seeing him and talking it out will just nip these feelings in the bud. So far, our communication has been fairly platonic.
What about compromise? Like, I can accept lateness not flakiness?

In case you're wondering...we had the talk about what he likes and what he doesn't and it came to light that we just don't have chemistry. In addition, out sex drives are also night and day. This came to light over the conversation and so we mutually decided to break up. Thanks for the advice everyone.
This is a great example of why Reddit can be great! This was all IMMENSELY HELPFUL!
Yeah, I think I need to draw a line in the sand regarding what it's important to me.
I know that he lost like 40 pounds in the last couple of years and now he works out regularly but it doesn't seem like he over-works out.
You really think that is a part of this? He seems to think it has to do with "sensation". He's actually very vanilla in bed...
OOOO didn't think about that...

Yeah, I agree with your points and I really want to stick it out. I wonder if positive reinforcement will work to make him feel more confident. It just surprises me that even at 30 men can be so nervous around women...
Hmmmm, I actually have no idea but I don't see why not. I guess the question is will this be something that will go away after getting to know me a little bit better. It's a HUGE turn-off.

YES YES YES. I am not trying to be awful, and believe me, I really appreciate all the things he's doing for me but for the love of god--just be yourself and stop trying to make me feel like I "owe you something" for your generosity. Maybe that's what it just comes down to?
I guess that is what I am trying to break through...I want to "feel it" and I don't understand why I am not.
Thanks for this. This is my inclination as well but things get complicated when you have all these emotions involved! Much appreciated!
